references.text: Shechem spoke lovingly to Dinah and tried to win her heart; the same expression 'speak to the heart' is used in both places.
Joseph spoke kindly to his brothers and comforted them, using the same Hebrew expression for speaking to the heart.
Boaz spoke kindly to Ruth and comforted her, using the same expression 'speak to the heart' to reassure and gain trust.
David was asked to speak kindly to his men, using the same Hebrew expression for speaking to the heart.
God commands that one should speak kindly to Jerusalem; the same expression 'speak to the heart' is used for comfort and reconciliation.
Abner was sent to bring Michal back to David, a parallel situation where a husband retrieves his wife.
The preceding verse explains that the concubine left him and went to her father's house, which motivates the man's journey.
The continuation shows how the father-in-law welcomed him and kept him there, expanding on the joy of their reunion.
